idea-plugin.name: LintBeam for Spring AI
idea-plugin.description:
Static analysis for Spring AI 2.x code: catches LLM cost and reliability mistakes while you type, before they reach production and your invoice.
  • Missing output limit – a ChatClient call without a max-tokens limit in .options(...), ChatClient.Builder.defaultOptions(...) or spring.ai.<provider>.chat.options.max-tokens. Calls that can only run on a provider with a documented default limit (Anthropic: 4096 tokens) are not reported; an option can show them as weak warnings.
  • Unbounded chat memory – session memory (SessionMemoryAdvisor, SessionAdvisors) without EventFilter.lastN(...) or compaction, and MessageWindowChatMemory with a huge maxMessages.
Works for Java and Kotlin.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0
  • First version: Missing output limit and Unbounded chat memory inspections for Spring AI 2.x, Java and Kotlin.
